events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Education] Create multi-week unit plans with Teach
events.titleJa: [教育] Teach を使用して複数週の単位計画を作成する
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Education] Create multi-week unit plans with Teach
events.summary: Educators can use Teach in Microsoft 365 Copilot to create structured unit plans that span multiple lessons or weeks. They can customize the plan components to organize connected lesson plans and quizzes across a unit. #education
events.summaryJa: 教育者は Microsoft 365 Copilot の Teach を使用して、複数のレッスンまたは週にわたる構造化された単元計画を作成できます。計画コンポーネントをカスタマイズして、単元全体で関連する授業計画やクイズを整理できます。 ＃教育
events.summaryEn: Educators can use Teach in Microsoft 365 Copilot to create structured unit plans that span multiple lessons or weeks. They can customize the plan components to organize connected lesson plans and quizzes across a unit. #education
